Several [[Kurzick Architect]]s were deployed to [[Urgoz's Warren]] to build a ramp and fix the teleporters to allow progression past the third room - but now there is only one left due to vampire attacks.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Urgoz's Warren}}

==Dialogue==
: ''"My team was sent in here to build an access ramp to some levers. It turns out the teleporter in that room was installed backwards. We managed to finish the ramp, but we were beset by [[Hopping Vampire|hopping vampires]] on our way out. One touch is fatal! If you run into them, keep your distance or you'll wind up like the rest of my team!"''

==Notes==
*Upon entry to Urgoz's Warren, the Kurzick Architect will start moving towards your party, he will remain stationary in the room before the starting area.
*He was added in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20111215|Thursday, December 15, 2011 update]] to remove the need for [[Consume Corpse]] or [[Necrotic Traversal]].
